journal: Journal of Industrial and Engineering Chemistry 15, 212-216
title: Measurement and correlation of high pressure phase behavior of carbon dioxide + water system
authors: Ji Min Han, Hun Yong Shin, Byoung-Moo Min, Keun-Hee Han, Ara Cho
experimental_method: Synthetic method in a variable-volume view cell: a loaded mixture of known composition is compressed to one phase, then pressure is lowered until the bubble point appears visually.
uncertainties_stated: T measured within 0.2 K (sensor 0.05 K, cell held within 0.5 K); p within 0.01 MPa; composition of prepared mixture 0.0002 in mole fraction.
quality_remarks: PDF is this paper (5 pages, no foreign pages). Only the loaded overall composition is known, bubble point at one composition per point; 313.2 K points lie close to literature (Fig. 3). Temperature scale not stated.
